title: Tanso炭素
tagline: Carbon credit registry and marketplace that connects carbon projects, verifiers and companies with carbon emissions
description: Tanso is a carbon credit registry and marketplace that facilitates all transactions onchain. It allows carbon credit project developers to receive their credits and sell/transfer them to companies with carbon emissions. Companies could discover and verify reputable carbon projects and buy credits directly on the decentralized platform.
how_its_made: The project uses ReactJS and Web3 technologies. The project uses EAS for carbon credits verification, reporting and purchases. For authentication it uses Worldcoin, and we have XMTP support for communication between different participants in the carbon credits marketplace. We use Figma for designing the website, VSCode, Javascript and EVM technologies. It is hosted and automatically deployed with Github Actions and Github Pages.
